item.title: Scenario: The Part Cuts in the Wrong Place (Work Zero, Set Program Origin, and the SheetCAM Origin)
item.description: The part cuts in the middle of the sheet, off the edge, or FireControl says it’s out of bounds. On a PRO without limit switches there are three things to line up: where the torch is when you press Zero All Axes, which corner Set Program Origin points at, and where SheetCAM put the part relative to its origin.
